# rauthy_auth_provider (Resource)

OIDC Provider resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rauthy_auth_provider" "github" {
  enabled = true

  auto_onboarding = true
  auto_link       = true

  name                = "GitHub"
  typ                 = "github"
  issuer              = "github.com"
  client_id           = "github-client-id"
  client_secret       = "github-client-secret"
  client_secret_basic = true
  client_secret_post  = false
  scope               = "user:email"
  use_pkce            = false

  authorization_endpoint = "https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize"
  token_endpoint         = "https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token"
  userinfo_endpoint      = "https://api.github.com/user"

  mfa_claim_path  = "$.two_factor_authentication"
  mfa_claim_value = "true"
}

resource "rauthy_auth_provider" "google" {
  enabled = true

  auto_onboarding = true
  auto_link       = true

  name                = "Google"
  typ                 = "google"
  issuer              = "https://accounts.google.com"
  client_id           = "google-client-id"
  client_secret       = "google-client-secret"
  client_secret_basic = true
  client_secret_post  = false
  scope               = "openid profile email"
  use_pkce            = true

  authorization_endpoint = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
  token_endpoint         = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
  userinfo_endpoint      = "https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Client ID
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client Secret
- `issuer` (String) Provider Issuer
- `name` (String) Provider Name
- `typ` (String) Type

### Optional

- `admin_claim_path` (String) Admin Claim Path
- `admin_claim_value` (String) Admin Claim Value
- `authorization_endpoint` (String) Authorization Endpoint
- `auto_link` (Boolean) Auto Link
- `auto_onboarding` (Boolean) Auto Onboarding
- `client_secret_basic` (Boolean) Client Secret Basic
- `client_secret_post` (Boolean) Client Secret Post
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled
- `jwks_endpoint` (String) JWKS Endpoint
- `mfa_claim_path` (String) MFA Claim Path
- `mfa_claim_value` (String) MFA Claim Value
- `scope` (String) Scope
- `token_endpoint` (String) Token Endpoint
- `use_pkce` (Boolean) Use PKCE
- `userinfo_endpoint` (String) Userinfo Endpoint

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Provider ID
